MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 12

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

7. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 10
   C. 15
   D. 5

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

12. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
